roles.after_migration: Independent flags; at least one role; a dual-role identity has one original ID

afm.original_value_during_migration: Preserved exactly, including NULL/empty and formatting
afm.canonical_key: vat_key, nine ASCII digits or empty; leading zeroes preserved
afm.normalization: Full-width digits map to ASCII; frozen whitespace and hyphens removed; optional case-insensitive EL prefix
afm.invalid_or_duplicate_legacy_input: Stop before changes; no automatic merge or deletion

version: record_version; zero initially; database advances on update
events: Append-only office/actor/entity-bound attribution; field names only, no contact/secret values
authentication: Existing users/password hashes, memberships and encrypted MFA data untouched
downgrade: Legacy-only reverse tested; new semantics require a reviewed preservation plan
